# Gcore Docs

> Official documentation for Gcore products: Account settings, Developer Tools, CDN, FastEdge, Edge Cloud, AI, Gclaw, Managed DNS, Public DNS, Hosting, Colocation, Object Storage, Video Streaming, DDoS protection, Edge Proxy, WAAP.
> Each product section has a dedicated llms.txt with the full article index.
> For the complete article archive in a single file, use [llms-full.txt](https://docs.gcore.com/llms-full.txt).
> Intended for offline indexing, bulk vectorization, or large-context retrieval.

## Products

- [Account settings](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/llms.txt): What a Gcore login controls and what stays with the account across every service (25 articles).
- [Developer Tools](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/llms.txt): Gcore services are available through REST calls, official client libraries, infrastructure as code, or an MCP server (31 articles).
- [CDN](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/llms.txt): Gcore CDN delivers websites, files, and video from an origin through edge servers, configured per CDN resource (125 articles).
- [FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/llms.txt): Run WebAssembly code on Gcore edge servers as HTTP applications or CDN applications, with Edge Storage, Cache, secrets, and local tools (33 articles).
- [Edge Cloud](https://docs.gcore.com/cloud/llms.txt): Run virtual instances and bare metal servers with disks, file shares, and private networks (113 articles).
- [AI](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/llms.txt): Gcore AI documentation covers Everywhere Inference for edge model deployment and GPU Cloud for accelerated training and fine-tuning (44 articles).
- [Gclaw](https://docs.gcore.com/gclaw/llms.txt): Gclaw is a fully managed OpenClaw AI agent with built-in inference on Gcore GPU infrastructure, chat access, and messaging integrations (10 articles).
- [Managed DNS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/llms.txt): Gcore Managed DNS is an authoritative DNS service with Anycast routing, dynamic responses, healthchecks, DNSSEC, and CDN integration (21 articles).
- [Public DNS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/public-dns/llms.txt): Gcore Public DNS is a free recursive resolver with IPv4 and IPv6 addresses supporting plain DNS, DoH, and DoT queries (4 articles).
- [Hosting](https://docs.gcore.com/hosting/llms.txt): Gcore Hosting provides virtual and dedicated servers, DDoS protection, DNS hosting, payments, and technical support (80 articles).
- [Colocation](https://docs.gcore.com/colocation/llms.txt): Gcore Colocation provides rack unit, full rack, and private cage options in data centers with power, cooling, network, and DDoS protection (5 articles).
- [Object Storage](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/llms.txt): Gcore Object Storage offers S3 and SFTP buckets with access control, presigned URLs, lifecycle policies, and CDN delivery (17 articles).
- [Video Streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/llms.txt): Gcore Video Streaming covers live and uploaded video delivery, transcoding, HLS and MPEG-DASH playback, player settings, and secure access (83 articles).
- [DDoS protection](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/llms.txt): Compare free Basic and paid Advanced DDoS protection, then open setup, monitoring, and pricing (13 articles).
- [Edge Proxy](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/llms.txt): Edge Proxy routes application traffic through the Gcore edge network to filter DDoS attacks and forward clean traffic to origin servers (6 articles).
- [WAAP](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/llms.txt): Gcore WAAP provides web application and service protection against attacks, bots, abuse, and common vulnerabilities (53 articles).

## Optional

- [Gcore MCP Server](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/gcore-mcp-server-overview.md): Connect AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) to Gcore via MCP to manage Cloud, CDN, DNS, and other products through natural language commands.
- [Full article index](https://docs.gcore.com/llms-full.txt): All articles across all products in one file. Use for offline indexing, bulk vectorization, or large-context retrieval.

# Gcore Docs - Full Index

> Complete article index across all Gcore products. 663 articles.
> Use this file for offline indexing, bulk vectorization, or large-context retrieval.
# Gcore Account settings

> What a Gcore login controls and what stays with the account across every service.

- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings.md): What a Gcore login controls and what stays with the account across every service.

## My profile
- [My profile settings](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/my-profile/overview.md): Manage Gcore profile settings, two-factor authentication, password changes, last logins, and login filters.
- [Set up two-factor authentication](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/my-profile/two-factor-authentication.md): Set up two-factor authentication (2FA) with an authenticator app, generate backup codes, and sign in securely.
- [Change or reset a password](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/my-profile/change-password.md): Change a Gcore account password from the profile settings or reset a forgotten password by email.
- [Missing password reset email](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/my-profile/password-reset-email.md): Troubleshoot a missing password reset email by checking spam, requesting a new reset, and contacting Gcore Support.

## Account
- [Account overview](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/account/overview.md): Manage Gcore account details, billing address, tax and currency settings, payment methods, services, and company account conversion.
- [Create an account for an individual or legal entity](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/account/create-account.md): Create a Gcore account as an individual or legal entity using email, Google, or GitHub, with contract options for businesses.
- [Create an additional account and switch between accounts](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/account/additional-accounts.md): Create an additional Gcore account and switch between accounts at sign-in when one login belongs to several accounts.
- [Disable or resume services](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/account/services.md): Disable or resume a Gcore service by contacting Gcore Support, noting that service data is deleted after the suspension period.
- [Account deletion](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/account/account-deletion.md): Requesting Gcore account deletion removes services and personal data, with a 10 day cancellation window and identity verification.

## Billing
- [Billing overview](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/overview.md): Gcore billing overview explains monthly consumption collection and PAYG charges for Cloud, CDN, and Streaming.
- [Expenses](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/expenses.md): Cloud project costs and reserved resource costs appear in Cost Report and Reservation Cost Report in Gcore Cloud Management.
- [Payments and payment methods](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/payments.md): Manage Gcore payments and payment methods, including history, statuses, filters, saved cards, verification, removal, and balance top-ups.
- [Bonuses and discounts](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/bonuses-and-discounts.md): View bonus credits, promo codes, and active discounts for a Gcore account, including bonus statuses, applicability, and debiting.
- [Trial conditions](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/trial-conditions.md): Gcore trial conditions list which services offer free trials, duration and limits, and how to start a trial.
- [VAT rates in different countries for an individual and legal entity](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/vat-rates.md): VAT rates for individuals and organizations by country, including EU reverse charge rules and 0% rates.
- [Tax location](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/tax-location.md): Find how Gcore calculates tax location from billing address and VAT number, and what tax rate changes mean for invoices.
- [Data deletion](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/data-deletion.md): Data deletion timelines after suspension, an inactivity pause, and a Free Service Period.

## Users
- [About users](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/users/about-users.md): Gcore user roles and rights explained, including Administrator, Engineer, and Purge and Prefetch permissions for account management.
- [Manage users](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/users/manage-users.md): Manage Gcore users by inviting, listing, updating roles and profiles, viewing account details, and deleting users.
- [API tokens](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/api-tokens.md): Create, manage, and delete Gcore access tokens with custom expiration, role assignments, and SSO support for automated processes.
- [Manage notification settings](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/notifications.md): Configure email notification settings for Gcore account users, including important, general, and product alerts.

## Support and resources
- [Technical support](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/how-quickly-our-support-team-will-respond-to-you.md): Gcore technical support response times depend on the support plan, request priority, and current team workload.
- [Monitor service status and maintenance](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/be-aware-of-the-service-status-scheduled-and-emergency-maintenance.md): Subscribe to Gcore Status Page updates for incidents and planned maintenance.
- [Roadmap: submit feedback and track feature development](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/roadmap-provide-feedback-suggest-new-features-follow-development.md): Submit feature requests and track their development status on the Gcore Roadmap public feedback board, with product boards and a changelog.
---

# Gcore Developer Tools

> Gcore services are available through REST calls, official client libraries, infrastructure as code, or an MCP server.

- [Developer Tools](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools.md): Gcore services are available through REST calls, official client libraries, infrastructure as code, or an MCP server.

## REST API
- [Gcore REST API](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/overview.md): Gcore REST overview covers authentication, base URLs, and a step-by-step learning path for all Gcore products.
- [API basics](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/api-basics.md): Gcore HTTP request basics cover choosing tools like curl, JSON responses, environment variables, and HTTP status codes.
- [Authenticate to the Gcore API](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/authentication.md): Create a Gcore token, set it as an environment variable, and verify it to authenticate requests.
- [Make the first Gcore API call](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/first-api-call.md): Set up a token, project ID, and region to make the first Gcore Cloud resource call.
- [How to use the API Reference](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/use-the-api-reference.md): Find an endpoint in the reference, send it in the browser, and read the status code and response.
- [API tools](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/tools.md): Use Postman, HTTPie, and VS Code REST Client to call Gcore Cloud endpoints.
- [How to use Gcore APIs with Postman](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/use-postman.md): Import an OpenAPI file into Postman and reuse a response value in the next request.
- [Asynchronous operations and task polling](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/async-operations.md): Gcore Cloud write operations return a task ID immediately. Poll the task until its state is FINISHED, then read created resource IDs.
- [Error handling](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/error-handling.md): Cloud error responses include a type code, a hint, and field-level validation details.
- [Pagination](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/pagination.md): Gcore list endpoints return paginated results using limit and offset, with count and results fields to iterate through all pages.

## SDKs
- [Gcore API SDKs](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/sdks/overview.md): Official Gcore SDKs for Python and Go, plus JavaScript fetch and axios options, with async task polling guidance.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/sdks/python.md): Use the Gcore Python SDK to install, initialize clients, make calls, paginate, handle errors, retries, timeouts, and async requests.
- [Go SDK](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/sdks/go.md): Use the Gcore Go SDK to make typed REST calls, initialize the client, poll tasks, paginate results, and handle errors and retries.

## MCP Server
- [Gcore MCP Server overview](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/gcore-mcp-server-overview.md): Gcore MCP Server lets AI assistants manage Gcore services with natural language requests and supports setup, clients, and permissions.
- [Install and configure Gcore MCP Server](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/install-and-configure-gcore-mcp-server.md): Install Gcore MCP Server and set the environment variables AI clients read.
- [Connect Cursor IDE to Gcore MCP Server](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/connect-cursor-to-gcore-mcp-server.md): Connect Cursor IDE to Gcore MCP Server and send a test query.
- [Connect Claude Code to Gcore MCP Server](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/connect-claude-code-to-gcore-mcp-server.md): Set up Claude Code with Gcore MCP Server, authenticate, configure the server, and verify the connection.
- [Connect Codex to Gcore MCP Server](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/connect-codex-to-gcore-mcp-server.md): Connect Codex to Gcore MCP Server and check that the server is enabled.
- [Connect OpenCode to Gcore MCP Server](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/connect-opencode-to-gcore-mcp-server.md): Install OpenCode, connect Gcore MCP Server, and confirm the server is available.
- [Available products and tools](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/gcore-mcp-server-available-products-and-tools.md): Gcore MCP Server products and tools cover CDN, cloud, storage, networking, security, DNS, FastEdge, IAM, and streaming.
- [Filter tools with GCORE_TOOLS](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/filter-tools-with-gcore-tools.md): Limit which Gcore MCP Server operations a client can call.
- [Explore and debug tools with MCP Inspector](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/test-tools-with-mcp-inspector.md): Explore and debug Gcore MCP Server tools with MCP Inspector, connecting over stdio or HTTP to test tool schemas and execution errors.

## Terraform
- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/overview.md): Gcore provider overview covers configuration and managing cloud, CDN, DNS, and WAAP resources with version-controlled infrastructure code.
- [Get started with Terraform](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/get-started-with-terraform.md): Set up Gcore infrastructure as code with the Gcore provider, from installation to applying configuration.
- [Manage a Terraform project](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/use-variables-and-organize-a-terraform-project.md): Manage an infrastructure as code project with input variables, sensitive values, and tfvars files for each deployment stage.
- [Import existing Gcore infrastructure into Terraform](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/import-existing-gcore-infrastructure-into-terraform.md): Bring existing Gcore resources under infrastructure as code management by importing them into state files with resource types and IDs.
- [Migrate from Gcore Terraform provider v0 to v2](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/migrate-v0-to-v2.md): Steps to migrate the Gcore provider from v0 to v2, covering resource renames, attribute changes, and manual re-import.
- [Copy resources across environments](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/copy-resources-across-environments.md): Copy resources across environments using variables and workspaces to keep preproduction and production configurations identical.

## Grafana
- [Install the Grafana plugin](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/grafana/install-the-grafana-plugin.md): Install the Gcore Grafana data source plugin for CDN, DNS, FastEdge, and WAAP statistics.
- [Create a Grafana alert rule](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/grafana/create-an-alert-rule.md): Create a Grafana alert rule on CDN, DNS, FastEdge, or WAAP statistics.
---

# Gcore CDN

> Gcore CDN delivers websites, files, and video from an origin through edge servers, configured per CDN resource.

- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn.md): Gcore CDN delivers websites, files, and video from an origin through edge servers, configured per CDN resource.
- [CDN packages](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-packages.md): CDN packages compare PAYG and Enterprise traffic, requests, shielding, image optimization, security, logs, and support.
- [How Gcore CDN works](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/how-cdn-works.md): Gcore CDN delivery model covering the CDN resource, edge cache, origin group, origin shielding, and connections.

## Getting Started

## Create a CDN resource
- [CDN resource overview](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/create-a-cdn-resource/overview.md): Compare Standard CDN and video delivery resource types, their features, use cases, and limits for delivering domains through Gcore CDN.
- [Create a CDN resource](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/create-a-cdn-resource/create-a-cdn-resource.md): Create a CDN resource with a Gcore domain or a custom domain, an origin, and the DNS record a custom domain requires.
- [Create a CDN resource for video streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/create-a-cdn-resource/create-a-cdn-resource-for-video-streaming.md): Set up a Gcore CDN resource for video streaming with HLS, MPEG-DASH, HTTP-FLV, or MP4 delivery, plus origin shielding and secure tokens.

## Integrate CDN with CMS and other platforms
- [CMS and platform integrations](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms.md): Guides for integrating Gcore CDN with content management systems, ecommerce platforms, forums, and cloud storage services.
- [Use an AWS S3 static website as a CDN origin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-aws-s3.md): Set up an AWS S3 static website as a Gcore CDN origin, configure a custom domain, and test content delivery.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with b2evolution](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-b2evolution.md): Configure a Gcore CDN custom domain for b2evolution static assets by editing the advanced configuration file.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Cloudflare](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-cloudflare.md): Set up a Gcore CDN resource with Cloudflare by adding a DNS only CNAME record and matching origin settings.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Concrete CMS](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-concrete5.md): Integrate a Gcore CDN resource with Concrete CMS using the Use CDN add-on to serve static assets through a custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Craft CMS](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-craft.md): Configure a Gcore CDN domain as the Craft CMS filesystem base URL so asset URLs resolve through the CDN.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with CS-Cart](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-cs-cart.md): Install the Universal CDN add-on in CS-Cart to rewrite image, CSS, and JavaScript URLs through a Gcore CDN domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Django CMS](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-django-cms.md): Configure Django CMS static and media URLs to serve assets through a Gcore CDN resource.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Drupal](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-drupal.md): Install and configure the Drupal CDN module to serve CSS, JavaScript, images, fonts, and videos through a Gcore CDN custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Google Cloud Storage](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-google-cloud-storage.md): Set up a Gcore CDN resource with a Google Cloud Storage bucket origin for public asset delivery through a custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with IPB](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-ipb.md): Configure IP.Board 3.2 to 3.4 to serve images, CSS, and JavaScript from a Gcore CDN custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Invision Community Classic 4.x](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-ips.md): Configure Gcore CDN custom URLs for Invision Community Classic 4.x file storage and troubleshoot integration issues.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Joomla](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-joomla.md): Integrate a CDN resource with Joomla using the CDN for Joomla extension, covering setup, configuration, and troubleshooting.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Kirby](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-kirby.md): Integrate a Gcore CDN resource with Kirby by setting media and assets URLs to a custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Magento](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-magento.md): Configure Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce to serve static and media files through a Gcore CDN resource.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Perch](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-perch.md): Integrate a Gcore CDN resource with Perch by updating config files and bucket paths to serve resources from a custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with PrestaShop](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-prestashop.md): Configure a Gcore CDN resource as a PrestaShop media server to cache and deliver store images, theme files, and module assets.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with PyroCMS 2.x](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-pyrocms.md): Configure a Gcore CDN resource custom domain in PyroCMS 2.x admin integration settings to serve static assets.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with SocialEngine](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-socialengine.md): Configure a Gcore CDN resource with SocialEngine to cache and deliver static JavaScript and CSS files through a custom HTTPS domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with TYPO3](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-typo3.md): Configure TYPO3 Replacer extension rules to serve generated assets and public files through a Gcore CDN resource.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with vBulletin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-vbulletin.md): Set up a Gcore CDN resource for self-hosted vBulletin 6, with caching rules for static assets and no-cache rules for private content.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Webasyst](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-webasyst.md): Connect a Gcore CDN resource to Webasyst by setting the CDN field to a custom domain and verifying asset URLs.

## Wordpress
- [Integrate a CDN resource with WordPress using the Gcore plugin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/wordpress/integrate-cdn-resource-with-wordpress-gcore-plugin.md): Integrate a Gcore CDN resource with WordPress using the Gcore plugin, including URL rewriting and troubleshooting.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with WordPress using WP Rocket](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/wordpress/integrate-cdn-resource-with-wordpress-rocket-plugin.md): Configure WP Rocket to rewrite WordPress static asset URLs to a Gcore CDN custom domain for faster edge delivery.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with WordPress using W3 Total Cache](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/wordpress/integrate-cdn-resource-with-wordpress-w3-total-cache-plugin.md): Set up W3 Total Cache Generic Mirror to serve WordPress static files from a Gcore CDN custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with WordPress using WP Super Cache](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/wordpress/integrate-cdn-resource-with-wordpress-wp-supercache-plugin.md): Configure a Gcore CDN resource with WordPress using the WP Super Cache plugin and its Simple CDN settings.

- [Primary, Backup, and Global Ingest Points for PUSH and PULL](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/primary-backup.md): Set up primary, backup, and global ingest points for PUSH and PULL live streams, with RTMP, SRT, and WebRTC WHIP protocols and failover.
- [Record live streams](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/record-your-live-streams-and-save-them-as-videos.md): Record live streams and save them as videos in Video Hosting, with manual start, stop, and recording settings.
- [Create and configure a restream](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/create-and-configure-a-restream-to-social-media.md): Create and configure a restream to forward live streams to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, or RTMP and SRT targets.

## RTMP, SRT, WebRTC
- [RTMP](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/rtmp.md): Configure RTMP and RTMPS live stream ingest with Gcore Streaming, including encoder settings, push and pull modes, and troubleshooting.
- [RTMP vs SRT: protocol comparison](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/rtmp-srt.md): Compare RTMP and SRT streaming protocols, including how each handles packet loss, jitter, latency, and limited bandwidth.
- [SRT](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/srt.md): Set up SRT live stream ingest with push and pull modes, latency, passphrase protection, encoder commands, limits, and troubleshooting.
- [WebRTC WHIP to HLS/DASH](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/webrtc.md): Stream WebRTC WHIP from a browser and get automatic transcoding to low-latency HLS or DASH for CDN delivery.
- [Configure low-latency ingest and playback](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/configure-low-latency-playback.md): Tune encoders and players for stable low-latency streaming, with fixes for stalls, slow segments, and device support.
- [Subtitles and captions in live streams](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/subtitles-and-captions.md): Pass embedded CEA-608 closed captions from a live ingest stream into HLS MPEG-TS playback, and learn about upcoming AI live captions.

## Q&A and Use cases
- [Streaming FAQs](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/streaming-faq.md): Answers to common questions about Gcore Video Streaming, including billing, AI video features, and live streaming.
- [Configure hot-swapping with AWS Elemental Live and Nimble Streamer](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/case-study-hot-swapping-elemental.md): Troubleshoot failed hot-swaps between AWS Elemental Live and Nimble Streamer by checking SRT late packets and PTS stalls.
- [Video streaming HTTP status codes](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/http-status-codes.md): Gcore Video Streaming HTTP status codes for manifests and chunks, including the X-Err-Code header for CMAF live streams.
- [Live Streaming issues](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/live-streaming-issues.md): Troubleshoot common Gcore Live Streaming issues such as buffering, empty manifests, SRT artifacts, RTMP freezes, and restream failures.
- [Solution: Live broadcaster](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/solution-live-broadcaster.md): Build a full-cycle live sports broadcasting workflow with ingest, failover, restreaming, DVR, clips, VOD, secure delivery, and statistics.
- [Solution: Live web](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/solution-live-web.md): Build a full-cycle live streaming workflow from the web browser with WebRTC, OBS over RTMP, LL-HLS, LL-DASH, recording, and secure delivery.
- [Solution: Video app](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/solution-video-app.md): Build a video sharing app with user uploads from mobile, transcoding, moderation, and playback in any web or mobile player with Gcore.
- [VOD issues](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/vod-issues.md): Troubleshoot common VOD upload, transcoding, and playback errors including HTTP 503, stuck Pending status, and slow segment latency.

## WebRTC issues
- [Fix the camera or microphone if they do not work](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/real-time-video-issues/fix-the-camera-or-microphone-if-they-do-not-work.md): Fix crossed-out camera or microphone icons in Gcore Real-Time Video by checking browser and system permissions, extensions, and network.
- [Audio quality is reduced when using Bluetooth headsets in video call apps](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/real-time-video-issues/audio-quality-is-reduced-when-using-bluetooth-headsets-in-video-call-apps.md): Bluetooth headset audio quality drops in video calls when the microphone switches from A2DP to HSP or HFP.

## Player
- [Built-in web player](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/player/customize-appearance-of-the-built-in-player.md): Customize the Gcore built-in web player with colors, logo, playback speed, autoplay, and embed options for live and VOD.
- [JS Video Player & SDK](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/player/player-api-tutorial.md): Gcore JS Video Player SDK supports LIVE and VOD streaming with HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4, plus custom skins and plugins.

## Statistics
- [Video player metrics](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/statistics/statistics-of-built-in-player.md): Video player metrics cover engagement, average view duration, viewer counts, audience browsers, geography, hosts, and operating systems.
- [Video views and delivered minutes](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/statistics/statistics-of-views.md): Track video views, unique viewers, and delivered minutes for one video in Gcore Video Hosting statistics.
- [View statistics of live streams and videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/statistics/view-statistics-of-live-streams-videos-and-billing.md): View statistics for live streams and videos in Gcore, covering viewers, browsers, geography, hosts, and popular videos.

## Video hosting
- [Getting started with video hosting](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/getting-started-with-video-hosting.md): Gcore Video Hosting stores, transcodes, and delivers video-on-demand content as adaptive HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4 renditions.

## Manage library
- [Upload and manage videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/upload-a-video-and-embed-it-to-your-app.md): Upload videos to Gcore Video Hosting, edit the name, description, poster, and directory, and embed them with a player or playback link.
- [Organize uploaded videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/organize-uploaded-videos.md): Organize uploaded videos in Gcore Video Hosting with directories and tags for grouping, moving, renaming, filtering, and deleting.
- [Delete uploaded videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/delete-videos.md): Delete uploaded videos in Gcore video hosting to permanently remove transcoded versions, subtitles, screenshots, and related files.
- [Download files](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/original-files.md): Download transcoded MP4 files from Gcore Video Streaming by selecting video quality in video settings.
- [Protect videos with AES-128 encryption](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/protect-your-videos-with-the-aes-128-encryption.md): AES-128 encryption protects HLS video chunks by using a keyserver to control access to the decryption key.
- [HEVC, AV1, and VP9 multi-codec VOD](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/multi-codec.md): Create HEVC, AV1, and VP9 renditions from VOD sources to cut CDN traffic costs with codec-specific HLS and MPEG-DASH manifests.
- [HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/hls-and-mp4.md): Compare HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4 delivery formats, playback links, manifest URLs, and quality ranges for Gcore video hosting.
- [Download and deliver MP4 files](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/download-mp4-files.md): Download and deliver MP4 files from Gcore Video Streaming, including per-quality downloads, speed limits, secure tokens, and byte ranges.
- [Create an illusion of a live broadcast with uploaded videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/create-an-illusion-of-a-live-broadcast-with-uploaded-videos.md): Schedule uploaded videos as a live imitation broadcast, with playlist order, start time, and active playback settings.
- [Videos with multiple audio tracks](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/multi-audio.md): Videos with multiple audio tracks let viewers switch languages during HLS and DASH playback.
- [Create and configure playlists for videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/create-and-configure-playlists-for-videos.md): Create and configure video playlists of up to 128 videos, set playback order, and copy the embed code for a website.
- [Video Lifecycle and Statuses](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/vod-status.md): Video lifecycle and statuses explained, from empty and pending through viewable and ready, with rendition progress and error handling.
- [Subtitles and closed captions for VOD](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/subtitles-and-closed-captions-for-vod.md): Add subtitles and closed captions to VOD videos with SRT or WebVTT files, including AI generated tracks and language selection.
- [Timeline hover previews: use with players and Roku devices](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/timeline-hover-previews-use-in-players-and-roku-devices.md): Timeline hover previews use storyboard tiles with players and Roku devices via WebVTT and HLS.
- [Upload and migrate via API](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/upload-video-via-api.md): Upload video to VOD storage by copying from external URL or using TUS resumable protocol, with batch migration and optional settings.

# Gcore DDoS protection

> Compare free Basic and paid Advanced DDoS protection, then open setup, monitoring, and pricing.

- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection.md): Compare free Basic and paid Advanced DDoS protection, then open setup, monitoring, and pricing.
- [How DDoS Protection works](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/about-ddos-protection.md): How Basic protection detects attacks and null-routes an address, and how Advanced protection filters traffic through GRE.

## Setting up the service
- [Service activation](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/service-activation.md): Activate Gcore advanced protection by choosing a plan, submitting a network, getting NOC approval, and applying settings.
- [Plan activation](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/plan-activation.md): Activate a Gcore DDoS Protection plan with a 7-day free trial, choosing clean traffic volume and network prefixes for GRE tunneling.
- [Network submission](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/network-submission.md): Submit a network for DDoS Protection by providing CIDR details, AS number, and a Letter of Authorization, then track NOC approval status.
- [Review and approval](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/review-and-approval.md): Network submission review and approval covers NOC checks, email notifications, and status changes for approval, rejection, or revocation.
- [Network configuration](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/network-configuration.md): Configure an approved protected network in Gcore DDoS Protection by setting the GRE endpoint IP and protection profile.
- [Custom protection profile configuration](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/custom-protection-profile-configuration.md): Create custom protection profiles with rules and policies for DDoS protection based on network traffic and security requirements.
- [Apply a custom profile to a protected network](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/apply-a-custom-profile-to-a-protected-network.md): Apply a custom DDoS protection profile to a protected network to activate its rules and policy.
- [Set a GRE tunnel with Gcore](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/gre-tunneling/set-a-gre-tunnel-with-gcore.md): Set up a GRE tunnel with Gcore for DDoS protection using Cisco routers or Ubuntu, including BGP and MTU settings.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/troubleshooting.md): Fix common network setup issues like submission errors, pending status, profile dropdown problems, and attack notification gaps.
- [Traffic Analytics](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/traffic-analytics.md): Traffic Analytics shows live DDoS traffic, mitigation decisions, top talkers, and clean P95 volume for protected resources.
- [DDoS log and monitoring](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/events-log.md): Review DDoS attack events from the past three months, event details, traffic graphs, source breakdowns, and attack email notifications.
---

# Gcore Edge Proxy

> Edge Proxy routes application traffic through the Gcore edge network to filter DDoS attacks and forward clean traffic to origin servers.

- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/overview.md): Edge Proxy routes application traffic through the Gcore edge network to filter DDoS attacks and forward clean traffic to origin servers.
- [How Edge Proxy protection works](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/how-protection-works.md): Learn how Edge Proxy filters incoming traffic, forwards connections to an origin, and deploys protection through proxy profiles.
- [Setup and configuration](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/setup-and-configuration.md): Set up Gcore Edge Proxy protected servers with origin addresses, DDoS filtering profiles, ports, proxy protocol, deployment steps, and the origin IP allowlist.
- [Supported applications](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/supported-applications.md): Edge Proxy filtering profiles for game, TCP, and UDP traffic, covering Minecraft, Counter-Strike, FiveM, Rust, and more.
- [Manage Edge Proxy](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/manage-edge-proxy.md): Manage Edge Proxy protected servers by enabling, disabling, editing, deleting, and monitoring traffic and metrics.
- [FAQs and troubleshooting](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/faqs-and-troubleshooting.md): Find answers to common Edge Proxy questions, DNS migration steps, and troubleshooting fixes for protected IP and origin issues.

# Gcore WAAP

> Gcore WAAP provides web application and service protection against attacks, bots, abuse, and common vulnerabilities.

- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/overview.md): Gcore WAAP provides web application and service protection against attacks, bots, abuse, and common vulnerabilities.

## Getting started
- [Configure WAAP for a new domain](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/getting-started/configure-waap-for-a-domain.md): Set up WAAP protection for a new domain by adding it, enabling it in CDN settings, monitoring traffic, and switching to Protection mode.
- [WAAP-protected domain management](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/getting-started/manage-domains.md): Manage WAAP protected domains by disabling protection, removing domains, suspending or deleting CDN resources, and checking domain statuses.
- [Billing](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/getting-started/billing.md): WAAP billing plans, billing units, domain zones, plan management, trials, and professional services are explained.

## Analytics
- [WAAP Analytics](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/analytics/waap-analytics.md): WAAP Analytics provides security teams visibility into protected domains, traffic patterns, attacks, and mitigation actions.
- [Dashboard](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/analytics/dashboard.md): Monitor WAAP traffic, attacks, and protection effectiveness across account and domain scopes with the Dashboard.
- [Events](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/analytics/events.md): Investigate WAAP security events and HTTP requests with filtering, inspection, and export options for incident response.
- [Domains](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/analytics/domains.md): Find protected applications and services in Gcore WAAP Domains and start domain-specific security analysis for incident investigation.
- [View WAAP statistics in Grafana](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/analytics/view-waap-statistics-in-grafana.md): Grafana panels for total WAAP requests and traffic across the account.

## Firewall
- [Access control](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/firewall/access-control.md): Gcore WAAP access control covers IP allowlists and blocklists, IP reputation, Check IP, CDN security policies, and custom rules.
- [IP allowlist and blocklist](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/firewall/ip-allowlist-and-blocklist.md): Manage IP allowlist and blocklist rules in Gcore WAAP to permit or deny IPv4 and IPv6 traffic by address or range.
- [IP Reputation](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/firewall/ip-reputation.md): Configure IP Reputation policies in Gcore WAAP to block, challenge, or allow traffic from TOR, proxies, VPNs, hosting services, and bots.
- [Check IP](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/firewall/check-ip.md): Verify the reputation of an IP address detected by WAAP and review its reputation tags and detection time.
- [L7 DDoS protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/ddos-protection.md): L7 DDoS protection detects application layer attacks and activates DDoS mode, with WAAP monitoring or protection modes.

## Default Rules
- [WAAP policies](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies.md): WAAP policies block malicious traffic, prevent data breaches, and filter suspicious IPs and bot traffic, with customizable policy groups.
- [OWASP threats](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/waf-and-owasp-top-threats.md): Configure WAF OWASP Top 10 threat rules, including CSRF checks, policy states, and enable or disable options.
- [Behavioral WAF](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/behavioral-waf.md): Configure Behavioral WAF rules to block brute-force attacks, probing, and obfuscated threats in Gcore WAAP.
- [CMS protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/cms-protection.md): Gcore WAAP CMS protection rules allow admin sessions, allowlist static IPs, and manage policies to prevent blocked CMS admin access.

## Custom Rules
- [WAAP rules](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules.md): WAAP rules define request inspection criteria and actions to block threats like SQL injection and cross-site scripting.
- [Custom Rules](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/custom-rules.md): Custom rules for Gcore WAAP define conditions and actions to allow, block, or challenge web requests, with rate limit and tag rules.
- [Policy overrides](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/policy-overrides.md): Policy overrides suppress false-positive WAAP detections for a defined traffic scope while default rules keep protecting other traffic.
- [Advanced rate-limiting rules](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/advanced-rules/advanced-rate-limiting-rules.md): Gcore WAAP advanced rate limiting rules control request counts within time windows using filters and exclusions.

## Advanced rules
- [Advanced Rules](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/advanced-rules.md): Create and manage advanced rules with Common Expression Language conditions, actions, rate limiting, and best practices.
- [Advanced rule objects and attributes](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/advanced-rules/advanced-rule-objects.md): Reference for advanced rule objects and attributes, including operators for Dict-type attributes in Gcore filtering rules.
- [Source field objects in advanced rule expressions](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/advanced-rules/source-field-objects.md): Source field objects for advanced rule expressions cover request, whois, session, response, tags, user-agent, and clientdata attributes.

## Tag rules
- [Tag rules](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/custom-rules/tag-rules.md): Create tag-based and tag-generating rules in Gcore WAAP to filter incoming traffic using predefined or user-defined tags.
- [Reserved tags](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/custom-rules/tag-rules/reserved-tags.md): Reserved tags are preconfigured tags that trigger actions in custom rules for WAAP traffic, login pages, automation, and LLM resources.
- [Predefined tags and their descriptions](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/custom-rules/tag-rules/predefined-tags.md): Predefined tags generated by behavioral analysis help filter and sanction web requests, with descriptions and slugs for each tag.

## Bot Management
- [Bot Protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/troubleshooting/enable-troubleshoot-bot-protection.md): Enable and troubleshoot Gcore Bot Protection, manage known bots, apply Lets Encrypt policy, and verify allowed bots and security actions.
- [Known Bots](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/known-bots.md): Recognize and allow legitimate bot traffic in WAAP with Known Bots, covering bot categories, verification, and bot mode settings.
- [Anti-automation and bot protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/anti-automation-and-bot-protection.md): Configure WAAP anti-automation and bot protection rules to block scanners, spam, headless browsers, and scraping.
- [Invalid user agent and Unknown user agent](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/invalid-user-agent-and-unknown-user-agent.md): WAAP bot management policies for invalid and unknown user agents detect and block requests missing standard browser identifiers.

## Threat Intelligence

## Security Insights
- [Security Insights](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/threat-intelligence/security-insights/security-insights.md): Security Insights sends system-generated alerts about domain misconfigurations, rule mismanagement, and vulnerabilities with fixes.
- [View and investigate insights](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/threat-intelligence/security-insights/view-insights.md): View and investigate WAAP security insights, including attack on disabled policy and allowed high-risk IP, with statuses and use cases.
- [Manage insight status](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/threat-intelligence/security-insights/manage-insights.md): Manage insight status by marking insights as read, silencing notifications, closing, and reopening them.
- [Manage Silence Rules](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/threat-intelligence/security-insights/manage-silence-rules.md): List, update, and delete silence rules for Gcore Security Insights to manage alert notifications and silence durations.
- [TLS fingerprinting with JA3 and JA4](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/threat-intelligence/tls-fingerprinting.md): TLS fingerprinting with JA3 and JA4 identifies clients by handshake parameters, with events, rules, and incident examples.
- [IP Spotlight](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/ip-security/ip-spotlight.md): IP Spotlight provides threat analytics for an IP address, showing global and domain activity, risk score, requests, and whois data.

## API Protection
- [API discovery and protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/api-discovery-and-protection.md): Endpoint discovery and protection with Gcore WAAP, including base path configuration and access control by reserved tags.
- [API discovery](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/api-discovery-and-protection/api-discovery.md): Discovery scans domain traffic to find REST endpoints, manage baselines, verify potential endpoints, and configure scans.
- [Configure API Protection policies using reserved tags](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/api-discovery-and-protection/configure-api-access-with-reserved-tags.md): Reserved tags configure Protection policies for endpoint authorization, token protection, and sensitive data exposure.
- [Manually add endpoints to the API base path](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/api-discovery-and-protection/configure-api-base-path.md): Manually add or remove endpoints on a domain's base path for WAAP protection and view current configuration.
- [Advanced API protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/advanced-api-protection.md): WAAP Advanced protection rules for application interfaces cover auth tokens, sensitive data, invalid traffic, and authorization.
- [Protocol validation](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/protocol-validation.md): Configure protocol validation rules for HTTP and HTTPS requests in WAAP Bot Management to block non-compliant traffic.

## Response pages
- [Response pages](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/response-pages.md): WAAP response pages cover browser validation, captcha, block, CSRF, and DDoS challenges shown for suspicious or malicious traffic.
- [Create custom response pages](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/response-pages/create-custom-response-pages.md): Create custom WAAP response pages for blocked, captcha, and browser validation messages, then associate page sets with domains.
- [Manage custom response pages](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/response-pages/manage-custom-response-pages.md): Manage custom response pages at account and domain levels, including page sets, updates, assignments, and deletion.

## Terraform
- [Manage WAAP via Terraform v0](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/manage-waap-via-terraform.md): Manage WAAP domains, security policies, custom rules, advanced rules, and firewall rules as code with the Gcore provider.

## FAQs
- [How does WAAP JavaScript injection work?](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/frequently-asked-questions/javascript-injection.md): WAAP JavaScript injection adds a challenge to responses to fingerprint clients and detect automated traffic.
- [What cookies and local storage does WAAP use?](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/frequently-asked-questions/waap-cookies.md): Cookies and local storage entries that Gcore WAAP sets on protected websites for security purposes.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/troubleshooting.md): Find fixes for common Gcore WAAP issues, including bot protection, blocked users, and 5xx errors.
- [Troubleshoot blocked users](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/troubleshooting/troubleshoot-blocked-users.md): Find why WAAP blocked or challenged a user by searching requests with a reference ID and inspecting rule details.
- [Troubleshoot 5xx errors](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/troubleshooting/troubleshoot-5xx-errors.md): Diagnose 500-class WAAP server errors, including 543 when all origin servers are down or unreachable, and review common causes and fixes.
